name: Question 3
problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬(A∧B)\,$ | $\,¬A∨¬B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Using your results, complete the following statement:

$$
¬(A∧B){{field-4}}¬A∨¬B
$$
worked_solution:
First, let's solve for the missing values:

- When $A≡\text{T}$ and $B≡\text{T},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬A∨¬B & ≡¬\text{T}∨¬\text{T} \\  & ≡\text{F}∨\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{F}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A≡\text{T}$ and $B≡\text{F},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬A∨¬B & ≡¬\text{T}∨¬\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{F}∨\text{T} \\  & ≡\text{T}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A≡\text{F}$ and $B≡\text{T},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(A∧B) & ≡¬(\text{F}∧\text{T}) \\  & ≡¬\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{T}\end{aligned}
$$

Our completed table is shown below.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬(A∧B)\,$ | $\,¬A∨¬B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |

To determine whether $¬(A∧B)$ is logically equivalent to $¬A∨¬B,$ we need to check whether their truth tables are equivalent.

Looking at the last two columns, we see that they are the same $(\text{F},\text{T},\text{T},\text{T}).$ Therefore, we conclude that 

$$
¬(A∧B)≡¬A∨¬B.
$$
